steps.speaker: Man under umbrella
steps.content: Haha... Given how immature these shackles are... you're pretty persistent...
The man disappears in the mist, but his voice still lingers in your ears. Your consciousness is gradually torn after being entangled in the dirt, and you lose your orientation.

steps.speaker: Man under umbrella
steps.content: As a reward, let me share with you something interesting.

steps.speaker: Man under umbrella
steps.content: This is Zoya's spiritual world. She's sacrificed herself to the Ring, so the Ring listens to her voice and responds to her wishes.

steps.speaker: Man under umbrella
steps.content: Isn't that incredible? She thirsts for destruction, and the Ring grants her power.

options: You've turned her into a monster.

steps.speaker: Man under umbrella
steps.content: Monster?

steps.speaker: Man under umbrella
steps.content: Hehehe... From your point of view, that's indeed true. But that's her genuine wish.

steps.speaker: Man under umbrella
steps.content: She was born a perfect monster.
She never wanted to become like this. She would never have chosen this kind of battle.
You're the one behind the inheritance, the manufacturer of Mania weapons! You've twisted everything, you've poisoned Syndicate, you've driven her to this!

steps.speaker: Man under umbrella
steps.content: Yes. I'm honored to be involved in the refinement process of such a perfect piece.

steps.speaker: Man under umbrella
steps.content: I must thank you too... Without the accident you brought about, we wouldn't have gained such a big pleasant surprise.

At this moment, the boiling emotions in your heart finally explode, washing away all your pain and weariness. Your senses suddenly become extremely sharp, and you're searching for the source of the voice...
You've found it. You swing your fist as you rush into the mist, hitting the target. You've never felt so much power within you. Clutching his collar, you drag the man out of the mist.
Half of his face is pulped now, transforming into flying dust. The other half is still smiling.

steps.speaker: Man under umbrella
steps.content: Hahaha, excellent. You're capable of controlling this world now. It has responded to you too.

steps.speaker: Man under umbrella
steps.content: Come on, you counterfeit. She and you are bound together by the shackles, and the Ring will respond to your wishes too.

steps.speaker: Man under umbrella
steps.content: Tell me, what do you want to do?
You can't help throwing a punch, eager to shut that smug mouth.
What happened to Zoya? How can I find her? How do I get out of here? How do I destroy the Black Ring?!

steps.speaker: Man under umbrella
steps.content: Haha... No, these are not your wishes.
Another punch, then another. A feeble blue light clings onto you as if trying to confine your power, but you crush it along with everything else.

steps.speaker: Man under umbrella
steps.content: Hahaha... Haha... That's not what you really want... Listen to your heart...

steps.speaker: Man under umbrella
steps.content: You only want me to die...
Shut up!
The somewhat persistent noise is plaguing your ears, trying to slow you down, but still you move to strangle his throat.
Another firmer voice is urging you: This one before you is an enemy you must destroy. You must destroy him. No one can stop you.

steps.speaker: Man under umbrella
steps.content: This is your mutual wish. The two of you are echoing each other. This is the power of the shackles, the power of the Ring...

steps.speaker: Man under umbrella
steps.content: Destroy everything then... The Ring will respond to your wishes...
Then die!
Red spikes echo your anger and pierce through the man before you. At the same time, the blue light strikes your eyes. The whole world lurches, and then shatters completely like a glass dome.
Wake up!!
You hear a familiar voice. Someone is desperately holding you back from behind to stop your action. After a brief stunned moment, that unknown emotion controlling you suddenly disappears.
You begin to smell the familiar smoke and rust. The enemies before you are gradually blurring, turning into a cloud of vague mist.

steps.speaker: Voice From Behind
steps.content: Don't sink into the Ring, come back to reality! Come back!

You stumble and turn back in a daze. Hella is curled up and sitting on her heels not far away from you, holding a frantic Hecate in her arms. Both of their bodies are brimming with faint contamination.

Confused, you reach out to them and try to control their contamination with the shackles, but then you see even more viscous filth emerging from your hands. Hecate wails, and Hella drags her back, holding her tight and looking terrified.

steps.speaker: Voice From Behind
steps.content: The shackles are very dangerous now. Don't get close to them.

steps.speaker: Voice From Behind
steps.content: Calm down, calm down. You're only affected by the Black Ring and being controlled by the Mania. You must get back to yourself.

What is he talking about? Your consciousness is blurred and your body is being dragged away. The sky seems to be hanging low. Rust-like contamination floats in the air on the square and continues spreading.
High in the sky, an enormous reddish-purple luminous ring is shrouding everything, twisting everything, and separating everything.

steps.speaker: Voice From Behind
steps.content: This is not your fault.
Your gaze finally returns to the chaotic mist before your eyes. It's gradually dispersing, and you see the opponent you've been fighting all this time.
A man in white armor stands before you with his head bowed. Four or five spikes have impaled his body and pierced through his left chest, fixing him in the air.
He presses his left hand on your chest. His hand seems to be clutching something—a Hyperpyramid. He takes out his own contamination shield and hands it to you.

steps.speaker: Voice From Behind
steps.content: This... is not... your... fault... Calm... down... Listen... to me...
You shakily open your mouth to call for the person before you, but you realize you don't know his name.
036 trembles. You think he wants to say something, but he keeps silent. His hand slides quietly, dropping to the ground with that drained and dim Hyperpyramid.
You hear a crisp shattering sound. The last bit of blue light goes out, and with that, your consciousness falls into an abyss.
